rules.explanation: LinkedIn's search algorithm boosts profiles that reach 'All-Star' status, making them up to 40 times more likely to receive contact from recruiters.
rules.do: Complete all mandatory sections: professional photo, custom banner, industry, location, current role/education, 5+ skills, and a minimum of 50 connections.
rules.dont: Do not leave core profile sections blank or without a designated industry and location.

rules.rule_name: Professional Headshot and Custom Banner Standards
rules.explanation: Profiles with professional headshots receive up to 21 times more views and 9 times more connection requests. A custom banner reinforces field specialization.
rules.do: Use a clear, high-resolution front-facing headshot (face taking 60% of frame) and a banner matching your technical field (e.g., tech ecosystem, clean branding).
rules.dont: Do not use casual selfies, cropped group photos, low-quality graphics, or leave the default background banner.

rules.explanation: Activating the 'Open to Work' feature specifically for recruiters increases inbound messages without making job-seeking public to current contacts if restricted.
rules.do: Configure target job titles, preferred locations (including remote options), and set visibility to 'Recruiters Only' or public frame based on preference.
rules.dont: Do not leave target titles empty or rely solely on passive profile presence without enabling recruiter signals.

rules.explanation: A clean, customized LinkedIn URL makes the profile easily searchable and professional when linked in CVs and portfolios.
rules.do: Customize your public URL to follow the format 'linkedin.com/in/first-last' or 'first-last-tech'.
rules.dont: Do not keep the default URL containing random numbers and letters (e.g., 'john-doe-8b9a2113').
